proposition_groups.live_delivery_claims: kept as marker-plus-call propositions with innings, bowler, batter, non-striker wording, legal-ball wording and arrival order
proposition_groups.revision_claims: kept as authority propositions tied to innings, marker, bowler, batter, repeated-marker call label and magnitude wording
proposition_groups.duplicates: pure replay repeats and archived highlight cards retained only as duplicate/stale signals
proposition_groups.audit_claims: ledger reconciliations retained as conservation checks, not additional play

cross_table_constraints: bowling runs = batter runs off bowler + wides + no-balls, excluding byes and leg-byes
legal balls determine batting balls, bowling overs, partnership overs and run rate
fall-of-wicket scores close the corresponding partnership rows
revised scorer authority overrides live ribbons; archived highlight cards do not override later rulings

classification_policy.NEW: first live delivery/ribbon or match fact entering state
classification_policy.DUPLICATE: same-delivery replays and repeated archived cards
classification_policy.REVISE: scorer-authority class or magnitude change for an open scorer line
classification_policy.RETRACT: superseded live class/magnitude removed by a later authority ruling
classification_policy.IGNORE: ledger conservation checks and stale highlight cards as play events
